info.description: Public content and permission-protected administration. Bearer tokens are opaque, database-revocable tokens. Public registration creates accounts without administrative roles.

structuredData.description: Optional additional schema.org JSON-LD with @context and @type or @graph. Maximum 64000 bytes and depth 16. FAQPage is generated from the visible FAQ fields.

gallery.description: Ordered additional project images. Keep image/imageAlt as the primary cover. Upload each file through the existing authenticated R2 media server route, then save the returned URLs here. URLs must be unique.

thumbnailUrl.description: Required public HTTP(S) or root-relative image URL used for terrain overview previews.

featuredImageUrl.description: Exactly one hero selection: must equal image or a gallery image URL. Defaults to image. Independent of the featured project flag.
